blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createStoreCreditAccountsWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow creates one or more store credit accounts after validating the input.

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows,
allowing you to wrap custom logic around store credit account creation.

steps.name: validateStoreCreditAccountInputStep
steps.description:
This step validates the input for creating store credit accounts. It throws an
error if no input is provided or if any entry is missing a currency code.

steps.name: createStoreCreditAccountsStep
steps.description:
This step creates store credit accounts. If no code is provided, a unique code
prefixed with "SC" is automatically generated. The step supports rollback by
deleting the created accounts.

children.name: CreateStoreCreditAccountsWorkflowInput
children.description: Data for creating a store credit account for a customer.

children.name: customer_id
children.description: The ID of the customer who owns this account, if any.

children.name: code
children.description: The unique code that identifies this account, used for anonymous or gift card accounts.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The three-letter ISO currency code of the account's balance.

children.name: credits
children.description: The total amount credited to this account.

children.name: debits
children.description: The total amount debited from this account.

children.name: balance
children.description: The current balance of this account (credits minus debits).

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs attached to this account.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the account was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the account was last updated.
